data.narrative:
Harmattan AI is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Mouad M'Ghari and Martin de Gourcuff, currently valued at $1.4B post-money following $200M in total raised capital. The valuation assessment triangulates against a comparable set of 10 companies across the defense and security sector—2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Dream Security, Code Metal, Castelion, Defense Unicorns, and Heven AeroTech, all at the same stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $1.4B base, implying $2.7B. The peer-median approach references 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B (range: $300M–$3.0B), with Dream Security at the high end at $3.0B and three peers clustered at $1.0B. These methods produced a triangulated range of $850M (low) to $3.1B (high), with a median of $1.8B.

The current $1.4B valuation sits within the lower-to-middle portion of the derived range, suggesting modest upside to the median estimate of $1.8B. Key uncertainties include variance in comp-set stage definitions and the wide dispersion observed across the six peer valuations ($300M–$3.0B). Earlier-stage positioning within Series B, relative market positioning, and capital efficiency metrics would refine the range further.
